mobile.doctor.daemon.not_installed: The phone service is not set up on this computer. To use the phone app, set up phone access on the Providers page.
mobile.doctor.daemon.not_running: The phone service is set up but not running, so the phone app shows this computer as asleep. Start it with lop mobile start, or restart this computer.
mobile.doctor.daemon.ok: The phone service is running and answered in {ms} ms.
mobile.doctor.daemon.slow: The phone service took {ms} ms to answer, which the phone app may show as not answering. Restart it with lop mobile restart; if it happens again, send this report to support.
mobile.doctor.daemon.gate_open: The phone service answered without asking for its password, so the phone portal is unprotected. Stop it now with lop mobile stop, then set a new password with lop mobile install.
mobile.doctor.files.ok: The phone service has {open} of {limit} files open.
mobile.doctor.files.near: The phone service has {open} of {limit} files open, close to its limit, so new phone connections can fail. Restart it with lop mobile restart.
mobile.doctor.files.unknown: The phone service's open files could not be counted on this computer. If the phone app shows it as not answering, restart it with lop mobile restart and send this report to support.
mobile.doctor.logs.clean: No open-file-limit or database errors in the last day of logs.
mobile.doctor.logs.errors: In the last day the phone service hit its open-file limit {emfile} times and could not open a database {sqlite} times. Restart it with lop mobile restart; if it happens again, send this report to support.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.not_configured: Phone access through Radient is not set up on this computer. To use your phone away from home, set it up on the Providers page.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.ok: Phone access through Radient is connected.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.single: This Radient account has one tunnel for this computer.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.duplicates: This Radient account has {count} tunnels for this computer, so the phone app may be connecting to an old one. Delete the older ones on the Tunnels page of the Radient console.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.list_unchecked: The account's tunnel list could not be read, so duplicate tunnels were not checked. Check your internet connection and run the check again.
mobile.doctor.login.missing: Not signed in to Radient. Sign in to Radient on the Providers page.
mobile.doctor.files.not_running: The phone service is not running, so it has no open files to count.
mobile.doctor.daemon.not_answering: The phone service is running but not answering, so the phone app shows this computer as not answering. Restart it with lop mobile restart, or restart this computer.
mobile.doctor.files.at_limit: The phone service has {open} of {limit} files open, which is its limit, so new phone connections fail. Restart it with lop mobile restart.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.login_needed: Phone access through Radient stopped because its Radient sign-in no longer works. Sign in to Radient again on the Providers page.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.setup_again: Phone access through Radient is linked to a sign-in or setup this computer no longer has. Set up phone access again on the Providers page.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.offline: Phone access through Radient cannot reach Radient right now. Check this computer's internet connection; it reconnects by itself once Radient answers.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.connecting: Phone access through Radient is still connecting. Wait a few minutes; if it does not connect, restart it with lop tunnel restart.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.turned_off: Phone access through Radient is turned off on this computer. Turn it back on with lop tunnel start to use your phone away from home.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.not_running: Phone access through Radient is not running on this computer. Restart it with lop tunnel restart; if it stays off, send this report to support.
mobile.doctor.tunnel.list_skipped: Duplicate tunnels were not checked because the Radient sign-in on this computer is missing or needs refreshing. Open Local Operator, sign in if asked, then run the check again.
